description: On the desk in front of you there’s a black USB hub with several ports, a black cable, and a short white USB adapter/cable. The left hand rests on and steadies the hub while the right hand moves in from the right, grips the white USB plug that’s inserted in the hub, pulls it straight out and lifts it up, then lowers the adapter and sets it down on the desk to the right of the hub, releasing it.
